proposedBoundedScope: Within each Kraken reference/asset-wallet stream only; anchor at an explicitly confirmed current holding. Existing actions, canonical IDs/payloads, opening protections and atomic journal/CAS boundary remain intact.
algorithm: Represent each exact before/balance observation as a distinct directed edge between integer decimal balances.

A residual complete trail from a fixed start exists iff the directed Euler start/end degree conditions and weak connectivity of all incident vertices hold; no tolerance, no source order, no inferred start.
At each step inspect outgoing rows and keep only those whose removal leaves a complete residual trail from that row's balance.
Exactly one feasible row: choose it. Two or more: true ambiguity remains blocked. Zero: disconnected/gap remains blocked. Empty remainder succeeds.
Maximum existing reference group remains 64 rows; no unbounded backtracking or factorial production search.

independentOracle.scope: All directed edge sequences over three numeric labels, zero through five edges, all three starts
independentOracle.method: Independent exhaustive remaining-edge traversal counts complete trails up to two, compares classification and exact sole row path.
independentOracle.forcedLocalBranchCase: 0→1,1→0,0→2 has one complete path from0; local-greedy ambiguity rejection would be wrong.

originalBoundary: Existing private original structure inspected without product mutation or provider requests. Source-internal continuity does not establish independent historical opening/closing balances. Cross-reference timestamp ordering remains separate.
